Tooltip_DanTraits_Inhaler: Quick relief for asthma. Each puff halves airway irritation. 10 puffs.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinPen: Rapid-acting insulin. One dose lowers blood sugar by about 50 over four hours, starting after fifteen minutes. 40 doses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_GlucoseMeter: Reads blood sugar from a drop of blood. Needs test strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_TestStrips: For a glucose meter. One strip per reading. 25 strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Metformin: For Type 2 diabetes. One pill a day lowers insulin resistance. 10 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinShort: Not enough left in the pen.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NotDiabetic: You have no reason to take this.
Tooltip_DanTraits_IronPills: Iron supplement. One a day keeps anaemia at bay. 30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NicotineGum: Takes most of the edge off a cigarette craving, without smoking. Quitting still takes three weeks without tobacco. 10 pieces.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Anticonvulsants: For epilepsy. One pill every 12 hours keeps seizures down. 30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Sunblock: Rub it in and the sun can't burn bare skin for 8 hours. Does nothing for a burn you already have. 8 coats.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Prednisone:
Steroid pill.
Treats: MS flares.
Dose: 1 a day during a flare;
it passes 3 times as fast.
Does nothing between flares.
Side effects: hunger.
20 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Baclofen:
Muscle relaxant.
Treats: MS stiffness and
spasms, heat stiffness too.
Dose: 1 every 12 hours
halves the stiffness.
Side effects: mild drowsiness.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Amantadine:
Anti-fatigue pill.
Treats: MS fatigue.
Dose: 1 every 12 hours; the
illness tires you much less.
Side effects: dry mouth
(a little thirstier).
30 pills.
